name: travel-a2ui
description: A travel chat + itinerary builder whose backend is a managed agent that speaks A2UI Express.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/express && npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/renderer && npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/mcp-view && npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/web && npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/gallery
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/express packages/renderer && tsc -p apps/web --noEmit && tsc -p apps/mcp-view --noEmit && tsc -p apps/gallery --noEmit && tsc -p apps/worker --noEmit
scripts.generate: python3 scripts/build_catalog.py && npm run build -w @travel-a2ui/express && node scripts/build_examples.mjs && PYTHONPATH=tools/skillgen/src python3 -m skillgen build --all --catalog catalogs/a2ui-travel/catalog.json --examples catalogs/a2ui-travel/examples --out skills
scripts.check: python3 scripts/build_catalog.py --check && node scripts/build_examples.mjs --check && PYTHONPATH=tools/skillgen/src python3 -m skillgen build --all --check --catalog catalogs/a2ui-travel/catalog.json --examples catalogs/a2ui-travel/examples --out skills
scripts.screenshots: node tools/e2e/chat.mjs --screenshot docs/screenshots/01-chat-light.png && node tools/e2e/mcp.mjs --screenshot docs/screenshots/05-mcp-view.png && node tools/screenshots/capture.mjs docs/screenshots
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run deploy -w @travel-a2ui/worker
